name: qa-portfolio-postman
description: Testes de API da ServeRest com Postman + Newman
author: Pietro Souza Cardoso

scripts.test: newman run collections/serverest.postman_collection.json -e environments/serverest.postman_environment.json -r cli,htmlextra,junit --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/newman-report.html --reporter-htmlextra-title "Relatório de Testes de API – ServeRest" --reporter-junit-export reports/junit.xml
